notes.title: Reality Core Release Date Announced: Dec 5th 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118379/30e09d7118117da55ce9ce03a092c42e897b5ffa.png[/img]

Reality Core officially has a release date for Steam!
The game will be out on December 5th, 2024.

Here is a list of some of the things I have done since the demo.

-3 new levels to explore
-15 new enemy types
-several new guns 
-3 new boss fights
-and end game sequence
-and more!

Be sure to check out the demo and Wishlist the main game!
Can't wait to see you in the multiverse.

-Wubs

notes.title: Demo Update: -Full Controller Support-
notes.content:
Hello!

I have pushed an updated for the demo, which add full controller support, a few new weapons and several quality of life improvements.

Thank you for your feedback so far! I'm closely monitoring  the steam discussions and our discord for more feedback. 

Whats New:
-New gun: Toaster
-New gun: Rebound
-Full Controller Support
-Boss events now give the player iframes at the start
-Several interaction bugs with the teleporter and pause menu have been fixed.
-UI changes.

Let me know what you think!
-Wubs
